name: Austin Zoo
tagline: Hill Country rescue zoo — lions, cheetahs, tortoises; not a megafauna safari.

practical.ticket_note: Rescue zoo (not AZA megafauna). Expect lions, tigers, bears, wolves, tortoises, hoofstock feed — no elephants/giraffes/hippos.
practical.best_start: Big cats first (cooler), then tortoises/reptiles, end at hoofstock feed if kids have energy.

bonus_hunt.tagline: Austin bonus · rescue cats + tortoise barn + hoofstock

challenges.text: Lions: mane fluff or sleek face — who looks more awake?
Cheetah: statue score 1–10 after 20 quiet seconds.
Galápagos tortoise barn: mid-step or statue?
Zebra/ostrich yard: stripes vs feathers — which is busier?

bonus_hunt.easter_egg: ★ Easter egg: find this zoo on a map/sign and point to a habitat you have not visited yet
bonus_hunt.easter_egg_little: ★ Easter egg: pick a favorite stop and tell a grown-up why

alpha_hunt.tagline: Austin Alpha · rescue deep cuts + free-roamers

challenges.text: ALPHA · Spot a peacock somewhere unexpected (roof, path, fence) — mark where
ALPHA · Capybara: count visible individuals without pointing twice
ALPHA · Wolf yard: 30 silent seconds — pack motion or still?
ALPHA · Alligator: only eyes/nostrils or full body line?
ALPHA · Cheetah: no talking 30s — one written verb
ALPHA · Zebra stripes vs ostrich feathers — which is better camouflage here?
ALPHA · Feeding Area: name three hoofstock kinds without a sign cheat
ALPHA · Read one rescue story sign — one sentence to a grown-up

alpha_hunt.easter_egg: ★ Alpha egg: find a habitat sponsorship plaque and read the family/name aloud
alpha_hunt.easter_egg_little: ★ Alpha egg: tip-toe past peacocks so you don’t startle them
